premises.text: Current public transit cards are based on outdated technology and lack user-friendly features
premises.evidence_span: current public transit cards, they give you access to public transportation. Yet, they are pretty stupid. You never know what credit you have on them. You don't know when your monthly pass expires.

premises.text: The Fidesmo card can be managed and updated using a smartphone or over the internet
premises.evidence_span: we have created the Fidesmo card, a card that can be managed and updated using your smartphone or over the internet.

premises.text: The Fidesmo card simplifies the ticket purchasing process for consumers
premises.evidence_span: they can top up their card while on their way to the bus, while waiting for the bus, from the hotel room or even from their home city.

premises.text: Public transport organizations can sell tickets without needing physical infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: they don't need a physical infrastructure for that. Instead, every phone becomes a sales channel.

premises.text: The public transit ticketing market is a large and growing opportunity
premises.evidence_span: only in my hometown Stockholm, they sell public transport tickets for 1 billion US dollars a year. In London, it's 6 billion US dollars a year.

premises.text: The Fidesmo card is based on widely adopted MyFair technology
premises.evidence_span: the reason it works everywhere is that it's based on a technology known as MyFair.

premises.text: Fidesmo invites other companies to build services on top of its platform
premises.evidence_span: Fidesmo is at the core an API. We invite other companies to build services on top of our platform.

value.text: Consumers benefit from a smarter, more convenient public transit experience
value.evidence_span: simplifying your life from day one in your home city, travelers will benefit from using the Fidesmo card in multiple cities.

notes: Patent status and demo details are excluded as traction.
